videos.title: Have you ever felt that electric rush when a creation finally comes together? Late at night, it is just me, my canvas, and a soft spotlight glowing over the studio. I twist the very last spiral, step back from the easel, and hold my breath. The colors are alive, the surface glimmers, and the whole painting seems to hum with energy. In that quiet moment, warmth spreads through my body, pure joy mixed with awe and intimacy, like falling in love with my own artwork all over again. That final curl is my favorite moment in the whole process, tender, powerful, and deeply personal ✨ #art #oilpainting #artstudio #brushstrokes #artist
